description: Florida-based coffee roaster (a brand of Howloo, Inc.) selling small-batch roasted coffee, flavored coffees, cold brew and a Coffee Club subscription direct to consumers, with a patriotic, first-responder-friendly brand identity.

evidence.summary: Blackout Coffee's own Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions (effective September 14, 2026) state the program is powered by Social Snowball and that affiliates earn a 15% commission on the product subtotal of each qualifying order (after discounts, excluding shipping, taxes and gift cards); subscription orders pay commission on the first order only. Referral links/codes give customers 20% off their first order; commissions are held 30 days, paid monthly between the 5th and 20th, with a $100 minimum payout. The terms state no earnings cap, so the cap is recorded as unknown, not uncapped.
The terms page publishes the program contact: 'Questions about the Program: affiliates@howloo.com' (Howloo, Inc. is Blackout Coffee's parent company).

The terms expressly invite promotion through affiliates' own social media, websites, email lists, video channels and podcasts, and grant the brand a royalty-free license to repost affiliate content tagged @blackoutcoffeeco or featuring its products with credit — a structured UGC/creator route, not gifting-only.
